title: feat(objectql)!: a flow, a webhook, a connector and an email template hold one name per package (bare-name phase 1, 3/4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAtn2B9TgkenAcW63kQpRgC)_

Refs #30803 (PR 3 of 4 — flow, webhook, connector, email_template)

Opened by `domain:server#1` (session_017xRBcTJTE7kSbcMoJQ4Txf); taken over by `domain:server#5` (claim 6713676993, card-thread session_01FEkQ5pr7Ua2kPRCMZNupZg) on triage's hand-over 6713649116.

PR 1 was #30836 (the data family), PR 2 #31006 (the request family); the last PR of the series carries the card's closing line.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) and item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) refuse, after the cold boot, a package registration they accepted before: one whose flow, webhook, connector or email template bears a name another installed package holds. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach that two packages may share a flow, webhook, connector or email template name, and the naming rule itself is phase 2's (#30805); the prescription ships in the refusal and warning text and in ADR-0048's 2026-11-06 addendum (P1.8).

⚠️ **Tier H**: this diff touches `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` (header, §3.4 note, P1.5, P1.6 and the new P1.8). The seat routes the approver.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：裁决 C 第一阶段的第三族。冷启动结束后，flow、webhook、connector、email template 这四类名字，一个部署只认一个包：安装门和注册口拒绝第二个包，422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`，点出两个持有包和改名建议（与 #30836、#31006 同一机制，不另起一套）。
- 为什么改：实测两包同名——自动化引擎只武装一个 flow（包 id 字典序靠前者，有告警），`/meta/flow/NAME` 却给先注册包的声明；webhook 派发只订阅先注册包的声明，另一个永不触发，无告警；`/meta/connector/NAME`（设计器的连接器选择器读的门）给先注册包的描述；邮件发送 `template: NAME` 解析先注册包的模板。启动后再装一个同名包，今天照常 200 并被静默遮蔽。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄接受集，不改任何已存数据；平台内置邮件模板包（`com.objectstack.service.email`）按既有契约（ADR-0131 D6，应用同名模板覆盖内置）被排除为"可覆盖基线"，既不持有名字也不被拒。基线常量只在引擎内部，不进 `@objectstack/objectql` 的公开导出。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`（四类加入列表、`OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`、`declaredBareNames` 按门的包 id 读基线）、`registry.ts` 的 `bareNamePackageHolders` / `sealBareNameHolders`（邮件模板 `pkg:name@locale` 键的成员剥离，是最有风险的 hunk）、ADR-0048 P1.8。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` ——预期 54 passed；或看 dogfood 文件 `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` 的四个用例。
- 需要你做的：ADR 改动是 Tier H，需要审批人批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** — the covered types grow from six to ten: the registry types `flow`, `webhook`, `connector` and `email_template`, listed after the request family (`BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` is now the one ordered list, `BARE_NAME_REGISTRY_TYPES` derived from it); their collection keys, labels (`email template`), consumer clauses and nouns, so a refusal's reason names what each consumer resolves. New **`OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`** / `isOverridableBaseline(type, packageId)` (module-level, not on the package index): per type, the packages whose items a consumer serves any other package's same-named item over by contract — today the email service's built-in templates (`com.objectstack.service.email`, `EmailServicePlugin.init`). `declaredBareNames` reads the manifest's package id the way the package door does (`artifactPackageId`: `id`, else `name`) and declares nothing of a type the package is the baseline of. Module doc: the four measurements, the baseline, what is not judged.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`** — `bareNamePackageHolders` and `sealBareNameHolders` read a bundled type's key through `bundleBaseKey` (`pkg:name@locale` holds the NAME), and the holder list drops a type's baseline package; the item seam skips a baseline package's own registration. Comments name the ten types.
- **`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`** — unchanged: `@objectstack/objectql`'s published surface does not widen. The booted pin holds the baseline's spelling by behaviour instead (see Verification).
- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** — the seal's comment names the ten types; no code change.
- **`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`** (Tier H) — the header's Addenda entry and §3.4's 2026-11-06 note name the ten types and the baseline; P1.5 keeps `agent` and `skill` as the last family; P1.6 names the baseline; new **P1.8** — the measurement, what is refused (the bundle, the connector kinds), the overridable baseline, what is not judged (the ADR-0146 declared override, ADR-0097's duplicate at boot, the kernel `metadata` service), the cold boot.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`** — the invariant names the third family and its served holder, the bundle reading and the baseline exclusion. Same ADR citations.
- **`.changeset/30803-bare-name-flow-family.md`** — `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, both declaration lines, BREAKING Before / Now / The overridable baseline / The cold boot / Who moves / Unchanged, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, measured producers.

## Why (measured)

Booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages (`com.qa.bare.alpha`, `com.qa.bare.beta`) sharing one name per type, in both registration orders, on `24bc2593`; then `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package (`gamma`) declaring all four held names:

| Type | Consumer | Served | Warned | Post-boot third package today |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `flow` | automation engine (`getFlow`, the bare-name flow map via `resolveFlowPrecedence`) | `alpha` in BOTH orders (lexicographically-first package id) | yes, naming both | `200`, shadowed |
| `flow` | `GET /meta/flow/NAME` | first-registered (`alpha` in alpha→beta, `beta` in beta→alpha) — so in one order the designer's body and the running body come from two packages | no | — |
| `webhook` | `declaredWebhooks.declaredWebhookNamed` (the dispatcher's reader) and `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` | first-registered; the other is never subscribed | no | `200`, never subscribed |
| `connector` (descriptor) | `GET /meta/connector/NAME` (the picker's read); `listItems` returns both | first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |
| `connector` (provider-bound instance) | automation service reconcile | the boot is REFUSED: `duplicate declarative connector instance name 'qa_shared_conn_live' — connector names must be unique (ADR-0097)` | loud (fatal) | after the boot: logged at `error`, skipped (code reading) |
| `email_template` | `email.renderTemplate({ template })` and `GET /meta/email_template/NAME` | first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |

The showcase boot also showed the built-in `auth.password_reset` bundle registered under `com.objectstack.service.email` only (four locales) — the showcase itself declares no override; the email plugin's loader serves any other package's same-named member over the built-in by contract, which is why that package is the overridable baseline rather than a holder.

## Verification

Stamped on head `c05d912a` = `e01df46c` (this PR's two original commits) + merge of `origin/main` `b3bd75d8` (`6bbbb4a7`, 93 commits, no conflict; the only main change in these files is `registry.ts`'s ADR-0146 pair lookup, `pairOf` → `pairsOf`, no hunk shared) + `c05d912a` (should-fix 1 and the nit of contract review 6703490135).

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` (54 cells, real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`): for each of the four types the data family's matrix — package door (both holders, rename, no record left), ABLATION before the seal, item seam, nested plugin, same-package reload (CONTROL), uninstall releases, environment registration never judged and never a holder (CONTROL), the cold boot (warns once naming both and the rename; reload keeps both, a third refused naming both; `'refuse'` refuses with the doors' envelope). Family-specific: the type list and its order; `declaredBareNames` over the four collections and a nested plugin, a bundle read once; a descriptor and a provider-bound connector instance hold the name alike; an email template's bundle is one holder and another package's member of that name is one conflict on the name; the item seam judges every member of a bundle; a holder is read from its member key alone (no claim) and the cold boot reads a bundled clash from the member keys; the baseline vocabulary, now also read by the door's package id (a manifest with no `id` whose `name` is the baseline declares nothing; one named for an app declares its template); CONTROLs — an app overriding a built-in template after the boot installs and a second app is refused naming the first app only, the baseline package is refused nothing at either door, the cold boot of the baseline beside an app's override is no clash, two apps overriding one built-in name warn naming the two apps and never the baseline; the reason names only the types it carries; a built-in flow name is refused at the package door. With the data- and request-family pins and `hook-binder.test.ts`: **4 files / 154 passed** on `c05d912a`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` (booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`): the cold boot boots and logs ONE `WARN` line naming the flow, the webhook, the connector and the email template, both packages and the renames, never the built-in bundle or its package, while the automation engine's own flow-collision warning still arms `alpha`; `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package declaring the held flow name is `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming both holders and `gamma_…`, the package list unchanged and the armed flow untouched; a package declaring the held webhook name plus the showcase's own flow and email template names is refused naming the showcase; CONTROL: fresh names install, and so does a package overriding the built-in `auth.password_reset` — the send then renders the app's subject, the built-in bundle still registered beside it. **The spelling pin, without the export:** the package the email plugin registered the built-ins under is read back from the registry, and the override's install is what holds the engine's spelling of it — were the vocabulary to spell that package any other way, the package would hold `auth.password_reset` and the install would be refused naming it (ablation below). On `c05d912a`: this file and the data and request families' dogfood files plus `email-template-materialization.dogfood.test.ts` → **4 files / 16 passed**.
- Ablations on `c05d912a`, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` or a trapped restore, restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:

  | Leg | Mutation | Result |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | src (new, the nit) | `declaredBareNames` reads the baseline by `manifest.id` again | unit file 1 of 54 red: the vocabulary cell, `expected [ { type: 'email_template', … } ] to deeply equal []` |
  | dist (new, should-fix 1) | `OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES.email_template` misspelt (marker in 4 built files), objectql rebuilt | dogfood pin 1 of 4 red: the CONTROL, `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED … declares the email template "auth.password_reset"` naming `com.objectstack.service.email`; restored, rebuilt, marker absent from all 14 built files |
  | dist (re-run, the dogfood file moved) | objectql's `bare-name-one-holder.ts`, `registry.ts`, `plugin.ts` at the merge base `b3bd75d8`, rebuilt (head marker absent from all 14 built files) | dogfood pin 3 of 4 red (no warning line; `gamma` and `delta` installed), the CONTROL green — the CONTROL no longer imports anything from objectql, so on the base it is a control; rebuilt from HEAD |
  | src (round 1 at `e01df46c`, code unmoved) | the four types removed from `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` / the baseline exclusion removed / the bundle member not stripped | 39 / 3 / 2 of 54 red — not re-run: the merge and `c05d912a` leave those hunks byte-identical |

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`: 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held, unchanged); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsc --noEmit` exit 0; eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/objectql/src` and the dogfood file exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `c05d912a` (merge base `b3bd75d8`, 8 paths): 84 derived families, every one run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran`: "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED" (exit 0). One rerun after a prerequisite: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`@objectstack/scenarios` had no `dist/` on this worktree; the seven packages round 1 named were built first) → built, rerun exit 0 (122 entry points / 72 packages load). `check:type-check-debt` exit 0 on the first run.
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, under `os-verify-lock`) at `c05d912a`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · Test Files 436 passed | 3 skipped (439) · Tests 3614 passed | 41 skipped (3655) · no failures (held the lock 1567s on a shared box). Ran because the title carries `!` and `Clause-②` carries the `(narrowing)` arm.
- Not re-run on the merged head (round 1 at `e01df46c`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both): the full `@objectstack/objectql` suite (565 files / 11476 passed) and `@objectstack/runtime` (553 files / 8882 passed, 19 skipped); CI's Test Core runs both on this head.
- CI on `c05d912a`, read once after the push: 35 success, 13 skipped, 2 failure — `Test Core (3/8)` and its aggregate `Test Core`, one cell: `@objectstack/scenarios` `test/runner/external-driver.test.ts` › "a full crm run through the command…" **timed out at 5044 ms** against vitest's 5000 ms default (no assertion failed; 572 of 573 passed). Not this diff: the test arrived with #31265 and drives a scripted CRM run through a spawned command; on this head it passed 4 of 4 locally (2973 ms when timed). Left for the seat to judge; nothing pushed to re-run it.

## Kept

- Same-name actions on different objects (`objectName:name`), jobs keyed `appId:jobName`, the unmanaged import's all-type refusal, the environment catalog (ADR-0005 overlay) and the ADR-0146 declared override of a base flow (a stored row); the automation service's own ADR-0097 duplicate refusal at boot; every data- and request-family pin green unchanged (`registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts`, `…-request-family.test.ts`, `hook-binder.test.ts` — 100 cells).

## Acceptance notes

- The measurement per type is the table above; the card's audit row for `flow` ("one armed, warning logged") holds, and the second consumer (`/meta/flow/NAME`) adds a silent split in one order.
- Not judged (stated in the module doc and P1.8): the kernel `metadata` service's `(type, name)` overwrite — on the composed runtime none of the four is read through it (the webhook reader falls back to it only with no registry).
- `GET /connectors` answered `404` on the showcase composition during the measurement (the route is not mounted there); the connector reading used `/meta/connector/NAME` and the registry list instead. Observation only.
- Round 2 (take-over): contract review 6703490135's should-fix 1 is closed by its route (b) — `OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES` stays off `packages/objectql/src/index.ts`, so the file leaves this PR's diff and the changeset no longer calls the constant exported; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` now reads true as written. Its nit (`declaredBareNames` read the baseline by `manifest.id` while the door judges `artifactPackageId`) is fixed in the same reader line. The ADR-0131 D6/D10 citation nit needed no change (the review said so).

## Series and out of scope

- PR4 (`agent`, `skill`, the card's closing line) follows this one; ADR-0048 P1.5 names it.
- A second app overriding a built-in template beside a first app's override is refused by this PR; whether the first app's override should itself be reported at boot (today: no warning, by the loader's contract) is left as the email plugin's own question.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is in Chinese by the seat's convention).
